**Package:** `dev.joid.base.opengl.snapshot` · **Module:** `base-opengl` · **Source:** [GlStateGuardBackend.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/base/opengl/src/main/java/dev/joid/base/opengl/snapshot/GlStateGuardBackend.java)<br/>
**Backends:** <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 2</span> <span class="joid-badge">LWJGL 3</span>

The base of the state guard backends of OpenGL: the surface of a snapshot backend, the traps each context supports and the state read through a binding.

## Description

A subclass sets the traps and draws like a host with the OpenGL functions of its library; [`Lwjgl2StateGuardBackend`](/reference/base-lwjgl2/lwjgl2stateguardbackend/) and [`Lwjgl3StateGuardBackend`](/reference/base-lwjgl3-opengl/lwjgl3stateguardbackend/) are the two official ones.
It ships in the `snapshot` jar of base-opengl and in the dev and demo jars of the backends; the published `joid-base-opengl` jar does not hold it.

## Learn more

- [Tools for hosts and tests](/build/base-modules/opengl/#tools-for-hosts-and-tests)
